title: java.lang.NoSuchMethodError when using json-schema-validator and quarkus-resteasy-jackson
body:
**Describe the bug**
Assertion on json schema is not working in Quarkus `1.9.0.Final` (it works with version `1.8.3.Final`).

**Expected behavior**
Test should be running.

**To Reproduce**

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. git clone https://github.com/dcdh/quarkus-sample-json-schema-assertions.git
2. do `mvn clean test` or run tests from IntelliJ;

```properties
# Add your application.properties here, if applicable.

```

**Additional context**
I guess it is a transitive dependency issue.
You can change version of `quarkus.version` in pom parent to 1.8.3.Final to check that it is working with this version.
I did not check if `1.9.0.CR1` is impacted.
